how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_096.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.ice_breaker.a: Prolonged use of the ability while falling, up until landing, will create a shockwave with a radius of %1$s blocks, dealing up to %2$s damage and knocking back nearby targets. However, the power of the shockwave also depends on the distance the wearer has fallen.
+1/5/10 experience point for each killed Zombified Piglin / Piglin / Piglin Brute.
+1 experience point for each additional trade from the ability «Respect».
Makes piglins neutral in relation to the wearer. The nearest piglin will indicate the location of a bastion nearby.
Each trade with piglins has a multiple 50% chance to yield an additional trade result, but the chance cannot trigger more than %1$s times.
+1 experience point for every 5 units of heating from the ability «Fiery Tread».

For %1$s seconds, allows walking on the surface of lava without sinking or taking damage. After the time runs out, the boots start overheating and deal damage to the wearer proportional to the level of overheating. To cool them down, the wearer must stay away from lava blocks. The cooling time also depends on the level of overheating.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.aqua_walker.d: +1 experience point for every 5 units of getting wet from the ability «Moisture Resistance».
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.aqua_walker.a: For a certain period, allows walking on the surface of water without sinking. Once the time runs out, the boots start sinking, pulling the wearer underwater. To dry them, the wearer must stay away from water blocks. The drying time fully depends on the level of saturation.
+1 experience point for each level of enchantment «Riptide» on the trident when using it.
Increases the maximum number of amulet equipment slots by +%1$s.
Reduces swimming speed by %1$s%% and increases the wearer's sinking speed by %1$s%%.
Increases the damage dealt by the player underwater by %1$s%%.
Allows the trident's «Riptide» enchantment ability to be used without rain or water, adding a cooldown of %1$s seconds per enchantment level.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.hunter_belt.d: +1 experience point for each attack made by the wearer's pet.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.hunter_belt.a: Increases the maximum number of amulet equipment slots by +%1$s.
Increases the damage dealt by the wearer's pets by %1$s%%.
+1 experience point for each experience gained by equipped charms.
Increases the maximum number of amulet equipment slots by +%1$s.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.rage_glove.de:
+1 experience point for every 3 charges from the ability «Berserker Rage» when they are reset.
+1 experience point for each target hit by the «Spurt» ability.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.rage_glove.ab: Each attack made by the wearer within %3$s seconds of the last one accumulates 1 charge in the relic's internal buffer. The player's damage increases by %2$s%% per charge, but they also take %1$s%% more damage. If the player fails to attack within the given time to gain another charge, the relic's internal buffer is completely emptied, nullifying all accumulated bonuses.
Increases the player's attack speed by %3$s%% and movement speed by %2$s%%, while also granting passive health regeneration of %1$s% per missing percent of the player's health.

When activated, performs a dash in the direction of the player's gaze up to %2$s blocks, igniting, inflicting bleeding, and attacking every target in its path with the item in hand. Deals additional damage to each target equal to %1$s per charge stored in the relic's internal buffer from the «Berserker's Rage» ability and then empties it, before going on cooldown for %3$s seconds.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.ice_skates.de: +1 experience point for each second of acceleration from the ability «Skating».
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.ice_skates.ab: Increases movement speed on ice by %1$s%% per second of sliding. The modifier stops increasing if the sliding duration exceeds %2$s seconds.
Upon collision with targets, deals %1$s damage per second of sliding from the «Skating» ability.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.amphibian_boo:
+1 experience point for each second of acceleration from the «Fins» ability.
+1 experience point for every second of acceleration from the «Slipping» ability.
Increases swimming speed by %1$s%% per second of swimming. The modifier stops increasing if the swimming duration exceeds %2$s seconds.
Increases movement speed in the rain by %1$s%% per second of movement. The modifier stops increasing if the duration of movement in the rain exceeds %2$s seconds.
With a %1$s%% chance, the player may not consume an air unit while swimming or in other conditions.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.chorus_inhibi: +1 experience point for every 10 blocks to the teleportation point from the «Teleportation Control» ability.
Using a chorus fruit teleports the wearer to a block along the line of sight within %1$s blocks, then goes on cooldown for %2$s seconds.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.wool_mitten.d: +1 experience point for every 5 units of size when hit by a snowball from the ability «Mold».
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.wool_mitten.a: Collecting snow with an empty hand using RMB gradually forms special hardened snowballs, up to a size of %1$s units. Hitting a target with such a snowball deals %2$s damage, stuns for %3$s seconds, and freezes the target for %3$s per unit of snowball size. Holding a snowball in the inventory without the relic equipped also freezes the player.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.roller_skates: +1 experience point for each second of acceleration from the ability «Acceleration».
Increases movement speed by %1$s%% per second of movement. The modifier stops increasing if the movement duration exceeds %2$s seconds. All blocks also become slippery for the wearer.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.space_dissect: +1 experience point for each created portal if there is no existing one

Holding RMB creates a portal at a point along the line of sight. Releasing RMB within a distance of %1$s blocks creates a second portal in the same way, linking it to the first. When a living entity approaches a portal, it is teleported to the linked portal. Portals do not function if impassable blocks are in their way. After %2$s seconds, the portals close and disappear.
Condenses matter beneath the relic owner's feet, creating a path through any terrain, even where no solid ground exists.

Creates a temporary phantom bridge beneath the player's feet that any relic owner can walk on. If the player stands still on the bridge for more than %1$s seconds, they will fall through and cannot get back up until they reach solid ground. While sneaking, the player is forced to fall through the phantom bridge blocks.
+%1$s experience points with a 10%% chance each time a bridge is created using the %2$s ability.
Grants the relic owner special elasticity, allowing them to bounce off any solid surface.
Increases the elasticity of all blocks by %1$s%% compared to slime blocks, enabling the player to bounce off them upon landing. When activated on the ground, it launches the player into the air.
+%1$s experience points for each bounce off a surface using the %2$s ability.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.leveling_sour: Each time any relic in the inventory gains experience, regardless of the method, %1$s%% of that experience is also gained by this relic.
items.lang|relics|info.relics.researching.wron: Working with the relic in this inventory is not possible. Move item to the player's main inventory and try again.
items.lang|reliquified_lenders_cataclysm|toolt: An eye torn from the socket of one of the legendary End monsters. Despite the years passed, it is still alive and searching for a target for its next battle...
Pursuit

Remembers the last target attacked by the player for %2$s seconds. When the ability is activated, the player is teleported behind the remembered target and the ability goes on cooldown for %1$s seconds.
Selected Target
Teleportation Conditions Met
Pursuit
+%1$s XP for each teleportation to a target using the %2$s ability.
A homework assignment of a student from the infamous magic school where students face deadly trials, capturing lightning, clouds, or vortexes in jars...
Void Tornado

Upon killing a target, summons a void vortex %1$s blocks tall that pulls in nearby targets and goes on cooldown for %3$s seconds. After 5 seconds, the vortex explodes, dealing %2$s damage to all nearby targets. If a weaker or equal vortex is nearby, it absorbs it, growing in size and extending its duration.
Void Tornado
+%1$s XP for each void vortex created by the %2$s ability.

A robe belonging to a mage who, according to legend, lived beneath the bedrock of any known world. There he mastered a never-before-seen magic of void runes and defeated a massive End beast, whose eye still roams in search of battle.
Invulnerability
Grants complete immunity to void damage.
Call of the Void
Every %1$s seconds, summons a void rune under a random nearby target, dealing %2$s damage.
Final Cry
Upon the death of the player or their controlled creature, summons a seismic zone at the death location with a radius of %1$s blocks, triggering void runes up to %2$s times, each dealing %3$s damage.
Call of the Void
+%1$s XP for each activation of the %2$s ability.
Final Cry
+%1$s XP for each activation of the %2$s ability.
One of the filthiest tools, not wielded by warriors or mages, but by 'butchers'. Its aura liquefies the air around it, hindering both movement and mind.
The Edge
Creates an area around the player with a radius of %2$s blocks that slows all targets trying to escape it by %1$s%% at the edge. The slowdown increases the closer a target is to the boundary.
The Edge
+%1$s XP for every 10 seconds of slowdown from the %2$s ability.
A fragile yet durable device that protects the head, body, and mind all at once.
Protective Bubble

Encases the player's head in a protective bubble, completely eliminating the need for air. The bubble also blocks up to %1$s incoming attacks before exploding, scattering %2$s shards in all directions, each dealing %3$s damage. It then regenerates after %4$s seconds.
Protective Bubble
+%1$s XP for each attack blocked by the %2$s ability.
items.lang|reliquified_twilight_forest|tooltip: The hoof of a beast that guarded the heart of the underground labyrinth. Rumored to grant its wearer the speed and endurance of the frenzied minotaurs.

While sprinting, gradually increases the player's movement speed up to %1$s%%. After 3 seconds of running, once the player reaches maximum speed, incoming damage is reduced by %2$s%%, and all nearby targets are knocked back and take %3$s damage until the player stops running.
+%1$s experience points for each instance of damage dealt using the %2$s ability.

The most valuable part of the multi-headed fire-breathing serpent that dwells somewhere in the fiery depths of the Twilight Forest. Though its original owner is long dead, the heart still beats, dripping with searing blood.
When taking damage, has a %1$s%% chance to drop a blood droplet that, upon landing, creates a damaging area for %3$s seconds, dealing %2$s damage to all targets and igniting them for 5 seconds.
+%1$s experience points for each blood droplet created by the %2$s ability.
The crown of the Twilight Forest’s very own king - the Lich. A symbol of his power and dominance. Legend has it that the true potential of this relic can only be unlocked by uniting all ten gems...
